## Product description

Oxford Notebooks Spiral Notebook 1 Subject, College Ruled Paper, offers an exclusive palette of citrusy pastels to enhance your school day or work routine with vibrant colors. This set includes six notebooks in pastel pink, orange, yellow, green, blue, and purple, adding a touch of brightness and organization to your tasks. Each notebook features 70 sheets of smooth, double-sided paper that resists ink smearing and bleed-through, making it ideal for gel pens and highlighters. The 8" x 10-1/2" college ruled pages fit more writing per sheet compared to wide-ruled paper, providing ample space for detailed notes. Each sheet is micro perforated for easy, clean detachment, ensuring that only the notes you want to keep stay in place. The 3 hole punched design allows these notebooks to fit perfectly into binders, keeping your notes organized and easily accessible. Made of premium coated paperboard, the durable covers protect your notes while adding a pop of color to your supplies. This bulk pack of six notebooks is an economical and practical choice for classrooms, home school, or office use, allowing you to stand out and color code by subject or student. Enhance your notetaking experience with the high-quality and vibrant Oxford Spiral Notebooks.
